label: preparing
what: A coordinated eighteen-sharp residents' gathering in the great hall with bread, refreshments, and a private presentation, plausibly honoring my forty years as mayor. The gathering itself was disclosed, but presentation details remain withheld. Innkeeper hosts and arranges an escort/no early arrival; neighbour and baker supply bread; builder relays collection arrangements. Secretary knowingly assists scheduling, while freight's grain handling and presence at the bakery suggest supply assistance, though his knowledge of the presentation is uncertain.
